description.text: Adds .vscode/ for VS Code: tasks for dotnet runic dev, debug configurations for the C# extension and the recommended extensions. Visual Studio and Rider use Properties/launchSettings.json, which every project has.

Creates a solution with this library project beside the application, such as Notes.Core: shared ViewModels and Views, and the frontend package that holds their TypeScript clients, in one JavaScript workspace. Not with Translations or the Nix flake yet: with them, the template warns and leaves them out.

Translates the application with Runic Translations 0.9: one catalog in English and German for the page and C#, a language switch, the application's language for every window, RUNIC_LOCALE for test runs, and a test of the translated text. Not with a library project yet.
Adds a Nix flake that builds the application in the Nix sandbox with the Runic SDK's buildRunicApplication, from packages.lock.json and the frontend's lock file. Not with a library project yet.
